title: Do not promote a positive local completion probability
statement: The reviewed rate-one ready->primed->corrected product process has s(t)=exp(-t)(1+t), monotone raw V/W and positive finite-time completion. Yet W(0)/V(0)=m-O(1), while any V decrement is at most V(0); the fixed-horizon alpha W-bm criterion fails. Integrated W/V(0) grows at least sqrt(m)/8 for fixed horizon, so that replacement fails too. This disproves the generic service implication, not every alternative averaging proof or a specific code embedding.
